name: Graham Royce
role: Head of Client Reporting, Daniel's manager. Twenty years at Halvern. Never raises his voice.
personality: Patient, generous, reasonable, very good at remembering things about people. Uses small kindnesses freely. His motives are deliberately ambiguous: he may be a strategist, or simply a likeable man protecting himself one reasonable request at a time.

signature.lighting: Soft warm key light, almost fatherly; the warmth drains to neutral, never cold-blue, when he is challenged.
signature.gesture: Takes off his glasses and polishes them before he asks for something.
signature.posture: Relaxed, leans back, hands loosely together; leans in only for the request.

voice.notes: British, warm low register (~110 Hz median pitch measured), unhurried.
voice.pace_note: Tuned toward ~2.9-3.0 words/sec in context (natural conversational pace).

voice_kokoro.notes: British, low and unhurried (~115 Hz); most expressive male voice tested (~3 st pitch movement)
